items.title: Apple's Annual Shareholders Meeting in 1984
items.description:
Shareholders Meeting where Apple CEO Steve Jobs announces the Macintosh.

This tape was recorded by Scott Knaster and digitized by video producer "majo".
You can read more about the tape here:

https://scottknaster.blogspot.com/2014/01/how-lost

My submission for the 2025 Public Domain Day remix contest!! Inspired mostly by the skeleton dance cartoon, but also by ponderance on the immortal nature of art and culture. When we give our time to preserving it we get so much back! Hope you like it.
